description: 玩家控制器 - 处理移动、旋转、交互、建筑模式

methods.name: _ready
methods.description: 初始化玩家控制器、加载设置、设置摄像机、抓取焦点

methods.name: _physics_process
methods.description: 物理帧更新：冲刺状态、摄像机拖拽、角色旋转、垂直运动、移动、摄像机跟随、交互目标、破坏、UI定时器

methods.name: _input
methods.description: 处理输入：鼠标按键（左键破坏、右键拖拽摄像机）、键盘（Tab切换背包、F3显示鼠标、G切换碰撞显示、B切换建筑模式、F交互）

methods.name: apply_camera_settings
methods.description: 从设置应用摄像机参数（灵敏度、高度、距离、角度偏移、拖拽启用/灵敏度、建筑拖拽灵敏度）

methods.name: refresh_camera_from_settings
methods.description: 刷新摄像机设置并更新跟随

methods.name: _update_sprint_state
methods.description: 更新冲刺状态：双击前进键开启冲刺，释放前进键关闭冲刺

methods.name: _update_sprint_fov
methods.description: 更新冲刺FOV动画

methods.name: _update_camera_drag
methods.description: 更新右键拖拽摄像机角度偏移

methods.name: _update_character_rotation_toward_mouse
methods.description: 角色朝向鼠标指针在地面投影点旋转

methods.name: _handle_movement
methods.description: 处理WASD移动输入，计算目标速度，应用加速度

methods.name: _handle_vertical_motion
methods.description: 处理垂直运动：重力、落地、跳跃

methods.name: _update_camera_follow
methods.description: 更新摄像机跟随：基于角度偏移计算位置，LookAt角色

methods.name: _update_interaction_target
methods.description: 更新交互目标：球形检测范围内的房屋

methods.name: _set_interact_target
methods.description: 设置交互目标并更新提示显示

methods.name: _try_open_interaction
methods.description: 尝试打开交互面板（按F键）

methods.name: _open_house_detail_for
methods.description: 打开房屋详情面板，加载居住者和可分配村民列表

methods.name: _on_house_request_assign_villager
methods.description: 处理房屋分配村民请求

methods.name: _on_house_request_unassign
methods.description: 处理房屋取消分配村民请求

methods.name: _toggle_inventory
methods.description: 切换背包UI显示/隐藏

methods.name: _toggle_build_mode
methods.description: 切换建筑模式

methods.name: _enter_build_mode
methods.description: 进入建筑模式：隐藏角色、显示建筑UI、正交投影摄像机

methods.name: _exit_build_mode
methods.description: 退出建筑模式：保存改动、恢复透视摄像机、显示角色

methods.name: _update_build_mode
methods.description: 建筑模式更新：摄像机跟随、预览更新、道路绘制、旋转手柄、村民持有

methods.name: _handle_build_mode_input
methods.description: 处理建筑模式输入：ESC取消、鼠标左/右键放置/删除、滚轮缩放/旋转、双击拾取村民/建筑

methods.name: _update_road_painting_step
methods.description: 道路绘制步进：按预算批量放置道路

methods.name: _cells_between_4_connected
methods.description: 计算两个单元格间的4连通路径

methods.name: _handle_road_right_click
methods.description: 处理道路右键：起点在路则删路，否则铺路

methods.name: _compute_quick_place_path
methods.description: 计算快速放置路径

methods.name: _apply_quick_place_path
methods.description: 应用快速放置路径

methods.name: _compute_quick_delete_cells
methods.description: 计算快速删除单元格

methods.name: _update_destruction
methods.description: 更新破坏进度：检测目标、更新进度、完成破坏

methods.name: _check_destruction_target
methods.description: 检测破坏目标：鼠标射线检测Area3D，距离检查

methods.name: _complete_destruction
methods.description: 完成破坏：掉落物品、销毁目标、重置状态

methods.name: cancel_destruction
methods.description: 取消破坏：取消当前目标、重置进度

methods.name: _setup_destroy_ui
methods.description: 初始化破坏进度UI

methods.name: _setup_build_mode_ui
methods.description: 初始化建筑模式UI

methods.name: _setup_villager_task_ui
methods.description: 初始化村民任务UI

methods.name: _setup_interact_ui
methods.description: 初始化交互提示UI

methods.name: _settings_load
methods.description: 加载游戏设置

methods.name: _settings_get_float
methods.description: 从设置获取浮点值

methods.name: _settings_get_bool
methods.description: 从设置获取布尔值

methods.name: _save_camera_angle
methods.description: 保存摄像机角度偏移到设置

methods.name: _toggle_debug_collision
methods.description: 切换碰撞调试显示

methods.name: _on_world_player_spawn_ready
methods.description: 世界就绪回调：设置玩家就绪标志

methods.name: _update_sprint_fov
methods.description: 更新冲刺FOV

methods.name: _update_destroy_ui_timers
methods.description: 更新破坏UI计时器
